name: project-forge-work-item-status
description: Shows evidence-backed Project Forge work-item status badges and provides read-only review-surface helpers in VS Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The extension reads local Git state and optional GitHub CLI pull-request evidence, and may open workspace review artifacts on explicit Project Forge commands.

commands.title: Project Forge: Refresh Work Item Status

languageModelTools.name: projectForge_openReviewArtifact
languageModelTools.userDescription: Open an exact workspace review artifact using the safest read-only review surface available.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use immediately before a Project Forge artifact-based human approval gate when the exact review artifact path is already known. Opens only that exact workspace-contained file and returns structured presentation evidence. It never approves, edits, commits, or guesses an ambiguous target.

path.description: Exact workspace-relative or absolute workspace-contained path of the PRIMARY review artifact. Do not infer it from editor focus.
